h2. Description

The *display switcher's hover tooltip should open above the switcher*, so it never covers the column header row. On staging it opens below and lies over the headers.

For example,
* in Tech View the List, Tech View and Board View tooltips open below the switcher and cover header labels (Clocked In, Lines, Total Price)
* the same happens at 1536 px
* in Board View they also open below the switcher

This appears inconsistent with the requirement defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10044*), the PRD and the design.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Tech View* in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar).
# Rest the pointer on each of the three switcher buttons.
#* Each tooltip opens *below* the switcher and covers part of the column header row.

*Actual Result:*
* The tooltip opens below the switcher and covers the column header row.

*Expected Result:*
* The tooltip opens above the switcher, as the test expects: *"Steps 2 to 4: each tooltip opens above the switcher, between the switcher and the tabs above it, never below it. While it shows, the table's column header row (Status, Waiting On Parts, Number …) stays fully readable, as in the design picture: no part of the tooltip lies over it."*
